body:
**Scoped negative result; no new kappa.** For PR555's frozen puncture set and keeper plan, changing the nine pseudo-target receivers cannot lower the shipped **439-helper** count. The complete **3^9 = 19,683** census finds 2,646 minimizers; the remaining assignments use 440–443 helpers.

The original discovery sampled 3–6 receiver choices per keeper-plan seed. This contribution closes that gap for the shipped seed 552 and its exact generator policy. It does not repeat the closed frame-only or decoder-copy searches. Other 439-helper words may still improve ADD counts, frame profiles or precision.

The complete helper bill is **240 carriers + 180 cell-empty helpers + 9 totals + extra carriers + new junk wires**. Ten independent supplying-block tables contain 60 entries. Their minima give **429 + 3 + 1 + 2 + 4 = 439**. A written separation argument and every local response/rank/carrier record are retained. This is optimality within the frozen generator class, not unrestricted circuit optimality.

### Reproduce

Ordinary Python 3.11+ with the inherited NumPy dependency:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/p111-receiver-census/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/p111-receiver-census/independent.py
python3 -I -B research/p111-receiver-census/test_package.py
```

Expected: `PASS_P111_RECEIVER_CENSUS cases=19683 local_rows=60 min_helpers=439 minimizers=2646 no_new_kappa`.

The main bitmask/block-table checker and a separately written set-valued full-vector checker agree on all records: SHA-256 `5598bbe4112493b6f6b55051a0364b7e576e253b8c2a85f8f05dcbb5d2ef7316`. They share pinned geometry/setup. The independent checker also completes 59 original-generator controls (55 distinct vectors), covering every changing block entry. Seven tests pass, including a failed-write mutation that falsely saves one carrier, punctured-zero and carrier-reuse controls, source/receipt corruption, and both checkers in a minimal offline copy with unchanged input bytes. All twelve base Git blob/source bindings and 17 selected-record tests pass. Optimized Python is rejected explicitly.

### Provenance and limits

Exact base: **007664306fff84fbb1c9a1b4053b69f439764034**. OS assignment seed **15**; bit supplier track. Only ten files under `research/p111-receiver-census/` are added. The published tree equals the tested local tree. Final overlap refresh reached #961; no coordination issue was available, so the local claim records the result and branch link.

Credit **eumemic #543/#555**, **DreamingOfClouds #545/#589**, and the retained construction lineage. The punctures, L3 plan, keeper assignment, ordered residual-carrier closure and junk-reuse rule are fixed. Arbitrary carrier vectors, other keeper plans, full native/hosted supplier admission and geometry formalization are outside scope. Uniform compilation, physical realization, hosting, precision/tape and analytic obligations remain unresolved by this package. Full repository verification, selected cold replay and hosted CI are not claimed. Selected PR890 conditional kappa remains **0.001661957774647029**.

Prepared for **ToikY** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**, including separate implementations and model review. No independent human review or formal multiplication theorem is claimed. Apache-2.0.
title: Scoped negative result: frozen P111 receivers cannot beat 439 helpers (no new kappa)
